_about: Questions written by a model from the R1043 record and each expert's own profile, then read by a person before being committed. Two per expert, because the card asks two: the core plus two follow-ups is the whole minute, and a pool larger than that means the two the rules pick are not the two anybody reviewed. The first is a decomposition or a conditional, the second is one of the debiasing roles, so every card carries one of the mitigations ACAPS's bias brief names. Every place and actor named here appears in the risk record itself (Adre, Tina, Abeche, Ouaddai, Wadi Fira, Sila, Ennedi Est, Darfur, RSF, SAF); nothing is invented, because a question naming a road that does not exist is worse than a generic one. No question states a count, a share or a threshold the model chose: a question asks which way something goes, not whether it clears a line nobody tracks.

_roles: Each question declares the role the card routes on: decomposition, conditional, premortem, base_rate, minority, observable, provenance, context. Step 3 always serves a debiasing role (premortem, base_rate or minority), so the ACAPS-named mitigations do not depend on thresholds.
